title: More Fluid Cans
description: Adds stackable fluid cans. The Copper Can from Tinkers Construct and new variants!
body:
More Fluid Cans adds fluid cans (fluid containers that stack to 16) based on the Copper Can from Tinkers Construct!

This is not an addon for TConstruct nor uses it as a dependency!

 

Currently adds:

  • Copper Can - Stackable container that holds 1 ingot (9000 droplets/111.(1)mB) of fluid
  • Emerald Can - Stackable container that holds 1 gem (8100 droplets/100mB) of fluid
  • Brick Can - Stackable container that holds 1 brick (20250 droplets/250mB) of fluid

 

Scope:

  • Make items datadriven to make adding custom variants easier for pack developers
  • Optimising code lol

Not in scope:

  • (Neo)Forge ports, these already have better options than this mod
  • Ports to newer versions, if the mod gets popular enough to warrant this I might do it

 

Credits:

  •  Code and Copper Can assets from Tinkers Construct by KnightMiner
  •  Code from Hephaestus by Alphamode

Huge thanks to them!!
